title: Understand Slope as Rate of Change Review Test
description: Interpret slope as a constant rate of change in tables, graphs, equations, and contexts.

questions.questionText: In a trail distance situation, y changes by 4 miles while x changes by 6 hours. What is the rate of change?
questions.explanation: Slope and rate of change both mean change in y divided by change in x.

questions.questionText: A linear relationship changes from x = 0 to x = 6, while y changes from 0 to 15. What is the slope?
questions.explanation: Slope and rate of change both mean change in y divided by change in x.

questions.questionText: A constant-rate table has change in y = -12 and change in x = 8. Which rate describes it?
questions.explanation: Slope and rate of change both mean change in y divided by change in x.

questions.questionText: For every 15 batchs, the amount changes by 25 cups. What is the unit rate?
questions.explanation: Slope and rate of change both mean change in y divided by change in x.
